tables.name: Dark Elf Naming Method
tables.description: All 50 results generate a given name + a family or house name. Court 36%; Deep 24%; Twilight 20%; Moon 16%; human-influenced 4%. This is ordinary method routing with 1d100, not a new runtime naming rule.
